classification: Engineering gap map/proposed next bounded increment; proposed interfaces are not PSL business policy or tested implementation

rows.observed_fact: Existing explicit role/time/eligibility delegation v1/v2; no typed invoice decision/action/case/currency/amount scope
rows.proposed_design: Add closed v3 invoice delegation scope with explicit case, decision type, verdicts, currency and maximum amount; unknown limit holds only financial delegation. Preserve legacy document behavior; scoped invoice delegation cannot become generic role authority.

rows.observed_fact: Current typed responsibility v1 has one direct native Finance review strategy
rows.proposed_design: Versioned v2 explicitly selects direct-only, direct-or-configured-delegate or unknown; no default operational selection. Resolve trusted current facts, expose configuration and routing explanation, hold dependent review while retaining useful drafting.

rows.observed_fact: Invoice approval/revalidation currently require direct role authority; InvoiceReview is the sole native ledger
rows.proposed_design: Typed explicit delegated mode bound to trusted invoice context, actual acting reviewer SoD and native D05 scope. Record/revalidate native authority; factory resolves mode deterministically. No second approval ledger or model-selected authority.

rows.observed_fact: Receipt-first uncertainty recovery and real PostgreSQL/process controls are tested
rows.proposed_design: Exercise actual configured delegate claim/decision/receipt chain plus unknown mode/limits, scope/currency/limit boundary, SoD, revocation/expiry, role and claim races, original unknown effect recovery and browser/configuration paths.

compatibility: Preserve v1 direct factory profiles and v1/v2 document delegations; additive typed JSON references, no schema migration currently proposed
policy_slots: Actual delegation people, bounds, dates and configured strategy remain owner decisions; fixtures explicitly synthetic
remaining_not_in_this_increment: Other release processes and shared coordinator/provider/background/restore/impact code
